editorialSummary: Nothing captures modern resourcefulness quite like global leaders botching the [COP31 climate talks](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/cop31-unlikely-derail-clean-energy-transition-experts-6577531) while corporate boards reinstate executives amid [Trump lobbying and SEC probes](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2026-11-24/huang-s-return-hits-the-reset-button-for-ai-bets) and chatbots generate massive proofs for [the Riemann Hypothesis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQZ0x4ejFTYkxaVjZTM3hTS0o5b2IteVFjczV3UHlJa0pzZjg5bmlGY1k3UXU5My1zamU5VnNBUXdtOWJ3aHBReFMtNDJhQktiVTJpMFBjN1daM1lMMGRGTzItRi12T0VxaTAxV3ZocUhRUG00RWxWc0k5S05qYmtJT1ZvMlNjWjZiNndZTA?oc=5). At least the joint space probes successfully entering [Mercury's orbit](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/epoca/noticia/2026/11/22/sonda-bepicolombo-entra-na-orbita-de-mercurio-apos-oito-anos-de-viagem-pelo-sistema-solar.ghtml) offer a convenient direction for anyone looking to quietly leave.
